sources.name: Wikipedia - List of most-visited websites (Similarweb ranks, top 50)
WsCube Tech - Top 100 most visited websites (cites Similarweb)
Semrush top websites - US / UK / Germany (top 20 each)

Semrush most-visited by category, US (software, finance, newspapers, retail, TV & movies, music, IT, distance learning, travel, sports, games, healthcare, real estate, recruitment, restaurants, online services) + global software
Ahrefs Top Websites - global / US / UK / Germany (top 100 each, organic search traffic)
Business Today - most popular AI tools (aitools.xyz, from Semrush/Ahrefs)

notes: Similarweb.com itself refused automated fetches (TLS reset), so Similarweb ranks come via Wikipedia (Aug 2026) and WsCube Tech (Jun 2026). Ahrefs ranks reflect organic search traffic and under-count direct-navigation tools (Gmail, Notion, Slack). Entries marked 'curated' were added because they are common tabs but did not appear in the fetched lists; their rank_hint is empty. In mixed rules, match '*' means 'everything else on this domain'; rules are ordered most-specific first. Excluded: Adult (pornhub, xvideos, xhamster, stripchat), gambling/lottery (bet.br, xsmn.mobi, sambad.com, bovada.lv), piracy (aniworld.to), proxies/ad-blockers/browsers (proxysite.com, getadblock.com, adblockplus.org, guard.io, opera.com), recruiting/HR back-ends and short links (paradox.ai, appcast.io, order.online, lnk.to, etc.), people-search (spokeo, fastpeoplesearch), single universities, India/Turkey-only gov or local portals, unidentifiable domains (grupogilleon.com, jackakhilautos.com, stockporthomes.org).
